newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oki Elec Installation cancels planned share issue.
newsitem.headline: Oki Elec Installation cancels planned share issue.

text.p: Oki Electric Installation Co Ltd, a unit of Japan's Oki Electric Industry Co Ltd, said on Tuesday that it had decided to suspend planned issues of new shares and a secondary offering of existing shares.
Yamichi Securities, the underwriter of the planned issues, said the company had also decided to suspend its planned listing on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's (TSE) second section later this month.

Oki Electric Installation said in a statement that the cancellation of the planned issues reflected recent market conditions and other factors. It did not say whether it would suspend its plan to list on the second section of the TSE.
On December 24, the TSE said in a statement that the company, owned 73.4 percent by Oki Electric Industry, planned to list its shares on the second section on January 29.
The TSE said the firm had said it would issue a million new shares and offer 1.5 million through a secondary offering.
